column5: ResourceGroupTagBuilder now marshals generated tidb-proto ResourceGroupTag with raw SQL/plan digests, nullable keyspace, always-present table_id, and row/index/unknown labels; request extraction, API-V2 key decoding, and session/kernel keyspace ownership remain outside this leaf

GetResourceGroupLabelByKey's row/index/unknown classification is ported through tidb-codec, while GetFirstKeyFromRequest awaits typed kvproto request envelopes and DecodeResourceGroupTag remains a future protocol utility
